elements.requirement: With the exception of section 21, the provisions of the National Minimum Wage Act 1998 apply to employment as a relevant member of the House of Commons staff in the same way as they apply to other employment.
elements.quote: Apart from section 21 above, the provisions of this Act have effect in relation to employment as a relevant member of the House of Commons staff as they have effect in relation to other employment.

elements.requirement: No rule of law or law or practice of Parliament prevents a relevant member of the House of Commons staff from bringing a claim under the National Minimum Wage Act 1998 before the High Court or the county court.
elements.quote: Nothing in any rule of law or the law or practice of Parliament prevents a relevant member of the House of Commons staff from bringing before the High Court or the county court any claim under this Act.

elements.requirement: A relevant member of the House of Commons staff is defined as any person who was appointed by the House of Commons Commission or who is a member of the Speaker's personal staff.
elements.quote: “relevant member of the House of Commons staff” means any person— (a) who was appointed by the House of Commons Commission; or (b) who is a member of the Speaker’s personal staff.
